verdict.rationale: Zoho Books ships a full REST API with OAuth2 token-based auth (refresh tokens allow non-interactive, scriptable calls), documented rate limits, and a downloadable OpenAPI spec — all of which support headless automation and CI-driven scripting of invoicing, banking, and reconciliation workflows. However, there is no explicit CLI tool, official SDK, or documented CI/CD pipeline example, and probes show no llms.txt or discoverable OpenAPI endpoint outside the docs page. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs, an official CLI or SDK for automation, and confirmation of server-to-server (no-browser) OAuth flow suitability.
